sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspaces" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "specs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workspace_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'backlog', "requirements" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "depends_on" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "phase" TEXT NULL, "agent_name" TEXT NULL, "worktree_path" TEXT NULL, "branch" TEXT NULL, "base_branch" TEXT NULL, "auto_advance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_advance" IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE ("workspace_id", "code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spec_steps" ("spec_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES specs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "step" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "session_id" TEXT NULL, "done_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("spec_id", "step"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "spec_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES specs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "workspace_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'backlog', "agent_name" TEXT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "requirement" TEXT NULL, "depends_on" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("workspace_id", "code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "task_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "agent_name" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "permission_mode" TEXT NULL, "worktree_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "branch" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running', "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "spec_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES specs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "steps" TEXT NULL, "effort" TEXT NULL, "cost_usd" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "tokens_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tokens_out" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "base_branch" TEXT NULL, "merge_commit" TEXT NULL, "pr_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("session_id", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conversations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workspace_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude', "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "claude_session_id" TEXT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ask', "tokens_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tokens_out" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cost_usd" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "message_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conversation_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "conversation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("conversation_id", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_prompts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "command" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "uses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_settings" ("agent_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "permission_mode" TEXT NULL, "budget_usd" REAL NULL, "max_turns" INTEGER NULL, "mcp_servers" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("agent_name", "scope"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mcp_tool_rules" ("server" TEXT NOT NULL, "tool" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("server", "tool"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_plans" ("workspace_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "step" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'vision', "data" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "planner_session_id" TEXT NULL, "cost_usd" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "materialized_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workspace_id"));
